Title: Generally Available: Fuzzy search in Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL full-text search

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL now supports fuzzy search in full-text search. With fuzzy search, you can deliver typo-tolerant, error-resilient search experiences directly within Azure Cosmos DB, helping your users find the right results even when queries or the data itself contain errors. This feature improves the quality and usability of search-driven applications, making them feel more natural and forgiving for end users. 

Learn more.
